params.body:
Measured on staging with the Server-Timing detail (#176): the Stocklist list render was 1.5 s, of which 0.95 s database, and 0.9 s of that was two statements: the search query (446 ms) and its count (448 ms). Two causes in that query:

1. CAST(vehicles.id AS CHAR) <= '20710': the July test-phase filter that hid vehicles whose photo folder had not been synced yet (string compare because the rsync ran alphabetically). A function on the primary key on every row, so no index. The sync has caught up, so the filter is off (StocklistBrowser::onlyMigratedPhotos = false, BiddingOfferBrowser both places). The plumbing stays for now; a follow-up removes it.
2. whereDate('available_on_stocklist_date', ...) wrapped a DATE column in date(), which kept MariaDB from using search_index (available_on_stocklist, available_on_stocklist_date). Plain comparison now, four places (also favorite_available_on_stocklist_date).

Expected: the two statements drop from ~450 ms each to tens of ms. I will re-measure after deploy and report the numbers.
params.title: Stocklist list: half the render time was a test-phase filter and date() on an indexed column
